title: Social analytics
description: Connect Meta (Facebook / Instagram) and TikTok to track follower counts, reach, and engagement for every channel in this agency. Tokens are encrypted at rest with a per-agency key.
forbiddenBody: Only agency admins can change social analytics settings.
dekBlurb: The agency DEK is wrapped by the platform KEK ({kek}) and stored in agency_social_dek. The plaintext DEK is shown to the agency admin exactly once at enable / rotate time and is never persisted or logged.
rotateBlurb: If the platform operator rotates the KEK, run pnpm tsx scripts/rotate-social-kek.ts --new-kek "$(openssl rand -base64 32)" to re-wrap every agency DEK.
kekMissingBody: The platform administrator must set the SOCIAL_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY environment variable before agencies can enable social analytics. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 32
enableExplainer: Enabling social analytics generates a per-agency encryption key. You will be shown a one-time recovery key to save in your password manager. The key is never shown again — losing it requires reconnecting every account.
kekWaitingMessage: Waiting for the platform administrator to set the KEK.
recoveryKeyModalDescription: This key decrypts your agency's social connection tokens. It will not be shown again. Save it in your password manager before closing this dialog.
recoveryKeyVersion: Key version {version}. The DEK is wrapped by the platform KEK at rest.
recoveryKeyConfirmLabel: I have saved the recovery key in my password manager.
confirmTypeMessage: Type the last 6 characters of the agency id ({token}) to confirm:
disableBody: All Meta and TikTok connections for this agency will be disconnected. Audit and metric history are preserved. This cannot be undone — you will need to re-onboard every connection to use social analytics again.
recoveryBody: This will disconnect every Meta and TikTok connection for this agency and generate a fresh DEK. Audit and metric history are preserved. You will need to reconnect every account after. This cannot be undone.
